intro.text: Common spren that appear with the wind. They can change shape at will but often look like ribbons of light.

description.text: They can stick things together, a simple form of the Surge of Adhesion.
Thousands ride the leading edge of a highstorm, and many follow its tail.
They are drawn to Radiants moving fast, such as Windrunners and Edgedancers.
Kaladin often draws them and has at least once controlled them, and with them the wind.
They use their sticking to play pranks, like fixing shoes to the floor or tying laces together.
They are rarely seen in Shadesmar, where one looks like a pinprick of light with a long trail.
Singers bond them to take nimbleform.

items.text: Bonded armor spren appear as tiny points of light and usually remain invisible to anyone but their Radiant.
